dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Kiara, how old are you?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Hmm, lemme think... One, two, ten... Uh, I can't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: But I remember coming to the Court of Fontaine with Carole and Neuvillette. That must've been a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Carole... Didn't Neuvillette mention her just now? That was more than four hundred years ago! Why would Paimon be a big sister to you?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: My memory isn't that good, but Carole told me I could address others based on how I feel about them... Paimon feels a lot more grown-up than me, so you're Big Sis.
